Keybinding.PartyHint: The road, the common purse and the party's notes.

imageBase.Name: Image folder
imageBase.Hint: Where place pictures named in the pack live on the server, e.g. worlds/my-world/visuals. A picture with a full path ignores it.

lockCompany.Name: Only the GM moves the party marker
lockCompany.Hint: Players own the party actor (for its purse and inventory), so they could drag its token. On an atlas, only the GM can move it.

snapRadius.Name: Snap distance (pixels)
snapRadius.Hint: A party token dropped this close to a place stops at that place.

purseForPlayers.Name: Players use the common purse
purseForPlayers.Hint: Players can put coins in and pay from the party's purse in the party window. Every change is written down with their name.

playerButton.Name: Party button for players
playerButton.Hint: A button in the players' token controls opens the party window.

textLanguage.Name: Default language
textLanguage.Hint: The language of the module's windows for everyone who hasn't chosen one.

language.Name: My language for Planar Atlas
language.Hint: Only for you, without changing Foundry's language.

showLabels.Name: Area names on the atlas
showLabels.Hint: Draw the names of wards and regions on atlas maps.

travelPrompt.Name: Travel time
travelPrompt.Hint: When the party token is dropped: ask (a small window with the estimate or the roll, which you can change), pass the time without asking, or never pass time.

useWorldTime.Name: Use Foundry's world time
useWorldTime.Hint: The atlas clock is Foundry's own world time (so effect durations and calendar modules move with it). Off: the atlas keeps its own clock.

showClock.Name: Clock on atlas maps
showClock.Hint: Show the in-world day and time at the top of the screen on an atlas.

hidden.Name: Hidden
hidden.Hint: The players don't know about it: no pin on their map.

rumoured.Name: Rumoured
rumoured.Hint: They've heard of it: a "?" pin and the rumour text.

known.Name: Known
known.Hint: They know what and where it is.

visited.Name: Visited
visited.Hint: They have been there (set when the party stops there).

Place.DeleteAsk: Delete «{name}» from the atlas? Its pin and its page go; the road keeps the visits by name. No file is deleted.

Card.Title: Place
Card.RumourDefault: You only know it's there; nothing more.
Card.TheaterHint: Show the Theater place «{name}» over the map
Card.DoneHint: Completed places count for the progress tracks (e.g. gate-towns → level).
Card.EncounterHint: Roll this place's encounter tables (whispered to you).

Form.RumourHint: What a player reads while the place is only rumoured.
Form.ImgHint: A full path, or a path inside the image folder (module settings).
Form.PriceHint: e.g. 2gp: the card gets a button that pays it from the purse.
Form.TheaterHint: Its name in Planar Theater (part of the name is enough).

Party.Title: The party
Party.Language: Switch the language of this window (only for you)

Road.PlaceCompanyHint: Put the party's token on this atlas, where the road left it.
Road.UndoHint: Take back the last stop and move the party back.
Road.HidePlayersHint: Players don't see the road on the map or in this window.
Road.ArchiveHint: Close this journey under a name; a new one starts where the party stands.
Road.ArchiveAsk: A name for this journey (e.g. «Ch. 2 — Sigil»):
Road.ClearAsk: Remove every stop of the current journey? Archived journeys stay.
Road.HiddenForPlayers: The GM keeps the road hidden for now.
Road.HowToStart: Put the party token on an atlas and drag it: every drop is a stop. Dropped near a place, it stops at that place.
Road.HowHint: Written on the next stop and used for its travel time.

Purse.NoCompany: The GM hasn't set up the party yet.
Purse.NoCompanyGM: There is no party actor yet. Create it: a dnd5e group with the heroes as members.
Purse.AmountHint: Coins: pp, gp, ep, sp, cp. A plain number is gold. Enter pays; Shift+Enter puts in.
Purse.OutHint: Pay from the purse (change is made for you)
Purse.SheetHint: dnd5e's group sheet: members, shared items, awards.
Purse.Empty: Nothing has gone in or out yet.

Error.NoCompany: There is no party actor yet.
Error.TooPoor: Not enough in the purse (it holds {have}).
Error.NoGM: The GM needs to be online for the purse.
Error.NoReply: The GM's Foundry didn't answer; try again.

Notes.Intro: A notebook for the whole party: what you found, what you promised, who you owe, where you want to go. Everyone can write in it.

Console.Title: Planar Atlas
Console.NoPack: No pack yet. A pack holds the atlases (maps), the places on them and their texts.
Console.ExportHint: Download the pack with the places as they are now (positions you dragged, edits, new places), to keep it in your files.
Console.AddHeroesHint: Add every player character to the group.
Console.PlaceCount: {n} places on the map ({pack} in the pack)
Console.ParkedHint: Parked at the bottom of the map: drag it to where it belongs.
Console.CreateSceneHint: Pick the map image; a scene is made at its size, without grid, vision or fog.
Console.BindHint: Use the current scene ({scene}) for this atlas
Console.SetUpHint: Create the pack's places on this atlas (and refresh their texts). Statuses and positions in this world are kept.
Console.SetsHint: One click makes every place of the set known to the players.
Console.SyncPagesHint: Rewrite the road and purse pages now (they update by themselves a moment after each change).
Console.NoScenes: No atlas has a scene yet (Setup tab).
Console.NewPlaceHint: A new place in the middle of the view; drag it where it belongs.

Enricher.reveal: Make it known to the players
Enricher.rumour: Let the players hear of it

road.Title: The party's road
road.Intro: Every stop of the party, written by Planar Atlas. Don't edit by hand: it is rewritten after each move.

purse.Title: The party's purse
purse.Intro: The common purse and every change to it, written by Planar Atlas.

notes.Title: The party's notes
notes.Starter: Write here what the party wants to remember.

Notify.OnlyGM: Only the GM can do that.
Notify.Failed: Something went wrong (details in the console, F12).
Notify.BackgroundFailed: The scene was made, but its background couldn't be set: set it in the scene's settings.
Notify.PlacesSetUp: {name}: {created} new places, {updated} refreshed, {pinned} pins added ({parked} parked at the bottom: drag them into place).
Notify.RevealedParked: «{name}» is revealed but still parked at the bottom of the map.
Notify.PackInvalid: The pack has {n} problems; the first: {first}
Notify.PackImported: Pack «{name}» imported. Now set up each atlas.
Notify.CompanyFailed: The party actor couldn't be created (is dnd5e the system?).
Notify.PrimaryPartyManual: Set it as the primary party from its sheet if you use dnd5e's awards.
Notify.NoCompany: There is no party actor yet.
Notify.NoCompanyToken: The party has no token on «{name}»: open that atlas first.
Notify.NotPinned: «{name}» has no pin on its atlas.
Notify.Locked: Only the GM moves the party on the atlas.
Notify.NoNotes: The party's notes haven't been made yet: the GM opens them once.
Notify.NoRollTable: No roll table called «{name}» in this world.

Clock.SetHint: Only the day count and the time shown change; Foundry's own world time is not moved.
Clock.ChipHint: The day and time in the world (Planar Atlas)

Travel.Title: The trip
Travel.NoRule: No travel rule for this: set the time yourself.
Travel.RuleMap: Estimated from the road's length ({amount} {unit} to cross the whole map).
Travel.Encounters: Roll for something on the way ({tables})
Travel.Hint: Change the time if you like; it is added to the clock and written on the stop.
Travel.Speaker: On the way
